lesson.meaning: To officially take a child into your family and raise them as your own, or to start using a new method, idea, or plan.
examples: My sister decided to adopt a child after many years of trying to have her own.
Our company plans to adopt new software to improve our project management.
The team needs to adopt a more proactive approach to meet the deadline.
Many countries have adopted policies to reduce plastic waste.
We should adopt best practices from other successful departments.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'adopt' as taking something *on* or taking something *in* – whether it's a new idea, a new system, or even a new family member!
